---
title: "Quickstart"
---

Each model gets its own folder, such as `data/bowser/`. Put the template PDF there (it is not committed) next to a YAML manifest, `data/bowser/bowser.yaml`, which maps PDF pages to cardstock colours. The conversion writes the SVG, the edge table and a status `README.md` into the same folder. Then:

```bash
make                 # all pages -> data/bowser/bowser.svg
make page PAGE=4     # one page  -> output/bowser/page-4/bowser.svg
make report          # check the result on the Results pages
```

Without `make`:

```bash
python -m src.lowpoly_pdf_to_svg --config data/bowser/bowser.yaml
python -m src.lowpoly_pdf_to_svg --config data/bowser/bowser.yaml --page 4 --output output/bowser/page-4
```

Open `data/bowser/bowser.svg` in Inkscape 1.2 or newer and work through the [guide](usage.qmd).
